plan_hint_dismount.context: Item of the amber hint line (MTB): signed "dismount". %1$s = total length

plan_hint_fords.context: Item of the amber hint line: water to cross. one = a single ford (no number), other: %1$d = count

plan_hint_barriers.context: Item of the amber hint line (bikes): several stiles / gates. %1$d = count (a single one shows its name instead)
